description.zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的 **边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The edge instance ID. To obtain the ID, go to the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), and hover your mouse over the name of the target edge instance.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. Pass this parameter for Enterprise instances.

title.zh: 解除边缘实例中已绑定的角色
title.en: Detach a Role from an Edge Instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
